title: A Town Refused Them Food. He Repaired Its Wall Anyway

meta.name: v5_k18_12_the-wall
meta.title: A Town Refused Them Food. He Repaired Its Wall Anyway

lines.text: A town refused them food. He repaired its wall anyway.
A wall is about to collapse. Mūsā says he could have asked for payment.
And as for the wall, it belonged to two orphan boys in the city, and there was beneath it a treasure for them, and their father had been righteous.

quran.ar: وَأَمَّا ٱلۡجِدَارُ فَكَانَ لِغُلَـٰمَیۡنِ یَتِیمَیۡنِ فِی ٱلۡمَدِینَةِ وَكَانَ تَحۡتَهُۥ كَنزࣱ لَّهُمَا وَكَانَ أَبُوهُمَا صَـٰلِحࣰا فَأَرَادَ رَبُّكَ أَن یَبۡلُغَاۤ أَشُدَّهُمَا وَیَسۡتَخۡرِجَا كَنزَهُمَا رَحۡمَةࣰ مِّن رَّبِّكَۚ وَمَا فَعَلۡتُهُۥ عَنۡ أَمۡرِیۚ ذَ ٰ⁠لِكَ تَأۡوِیلُ مَا لَمۡ تَسۡطِع عَّلَیۡهِ صَبۡرࣰا

lines.text: So your Lord intended that they reach maturity and extract their treasure, as a mercy from your Lord.
